# Passive mythical fauna sources

Downloaded 2026-11-06 from the public sample catalog https://afk.ai/samples .
Selected sources: Icy Dragon by chengzijieczj and Crystal deer by Coffeek, each
explicitly CC BY 4.0. Original-author public Sketchfab API metadata independently
confirmed both licenses. Relevant metadata and source hashes are retained beside
the files. No login, paid rigging service or AI upload was used.

The sample GLBs are static: Godot inspection found zero skeletons/AnimationPlayers.
Dragon: 44,997 triangles; deer: 18,088 triangles. Imported textures/materials remain.
The game copies only static MeshInstance3D geometry/materials into a decorative
Node3D; no source behavior, damage receiver, hitbox or collision is introduced.
Placement/size/orientation and tiny breathing scale are the integration changes.
Fox derivative uses the separately credited existing source, not a new download.
The crystal deer was inspected but rejected for current map placement because
its stylized proportions/color did not match the owner's realism direction. It
remains a credited source candidate, not a claimed in-world encounter.

These are credited artists' models, not original project-authored creature models.
Detailed textured assets improve realism, but do not establish photoreal output
or production animation quality in the current game/mobile renderer.

0.5.8 owner direction supersedes the bright fairy treatment: active creatures are
dark, single-tailed hounds and ash-colored dragons. Original GLBs stay unchanged;
material copies keep their texture/normal maps. Deer remains an unused candidate.
